import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

XML = """<mujoco model="go2">
  <compiler angle="radian" meshdir="assets" autolimits="true" />
  <default>
    <default class="go2">
      <geom friction="0.4" margin="0.001" condim="1"/>
      <joint axis="0 1 0" damping="0.1" armature="0.01" frictionloss="0.2"/>
      <motor ctrlrange="-23.7 23.7"/>
      <default class="abduction">
        <joint axis="1 0 0" range="-1.0472 1.0472"/>
      </default>
      <default class="front_hip">
        <joint range="-1.5708 3.4907"/>
      </default>
      <default class="back_hip">
        <joint range="-0.5236 4.5379"/>
      </default>
      <default class="knee">
        <joint range="-2.7227 -0.83776"/>
        <motor ctrlrange="-45.43 45.43"/>
      </default>
    </default>
  </default>
</mujoco>"""

# Resolve defaults from the XML we read
defaults = {
    "abduction": {"axis": [1,0,0], "range": [-1.0472, 1.0472], "motor_ctrlrange": [-23.7, 23.7]},
    "front_hip": {"axis": [0,1,0], "range": [-1.5708, 3.4907], "motor_ctrlrange": [-23.7, 23.7]},
    "back_hip":  {"axis": [0,1,0], "range": [-0.5236, 4.5379], "motor_ctrlrange": [-23.7, 23.7]},
    "knee":      {"axis": [0,1,0], "range": [-2.7227, -0.83776], "motor_ctrlrange": [-45.43, 45.43]},
}

# Joint definitions from the XML
joints_raw = [
    # FL leg
    {"name": "FL_hip_joint",   "class": "abduction"},
    {"name": "FL_thigh_joint", "class": "front_hip"},
    {"name": "FL_calf_joint",  "class": "knee"},
    # FR leg
    {"name": "FR_hip_joint",   "class": "abduction"},
    {"name": "FR_thigh_joint", "class": "front_hip"},
    {"name": "FR_calf_joint",  "class": "knee"},
    # RL leg
    {"name": "RL_hip_joint",   "class": "abduction"},
    {"name": "RL_thigh_joint", "class": "back_hip"},
    {"name": "RL_calf_joint",  "class": "knee"},
    # RR leg
    {"name": "RR_hip_joint",   "class": "abduction"},
    {"name": "RR_thigh_joint", "class": "back_hip"},
    {"name": "RR_calf_joint",  "class": "knee"},
]

joints = []
for j in joints_raw:
    d = defaults[j["class"]]
    joints.append({
        "name": j["name"],
        "type": "hinge",
        "axis": d["axis"],
        "ctrlrange": d["range"],
    })

print("Joints:")
for j in joints:
    print(f"  {j['name']:25s}  axis={j['axis']}  range={j['ctrlrange']}")
print(f"\nTotal joints: {len(joints)}")
